stories.headline: Lionel Messi takes a Spanish prize for his football career
stories.summary: Lionel Messi has been given the 2026 Princess of Asturias Award for Sports, for his career at FC Barcelona. The Spanish awards are presented each October at the Campoamor Theatre in Oviedo by Leonor, Princess of Asturias, and each category carries €50,000. The jury called him the player who has won the most titles in the history of football.

stories.headline: Raye wins this year's Mercury Prize
stories.summary: The British singer Raye has won the 2026 Mercury Prize for her album This Music May Contain Hope. The prize goes each year to the best album by an act from the United Kingdom or Ireland, chosen from a shortlist of twelve. The winner receives a cheque for £25,000 and a trophy.

stories.headline: Greece bars children under 15 from social media
stories.summary: Greece's parliament has approved a law banning children under 15 from using social media, starting on 1 January 2027. Platforms will have to verify ages, and those that fail to comply face penalties.

stories.headline: A rare king's coin in Norway's Viking silver hoard
stories.summary: Metal detectorists found a cache of 1,000-year-old silver coins in eastern Norway in April. While cataloguing the Mørstad hoard, an archaeologist spotted an exceedingly rare coin minted for Olaf II Haraldsson, a king who later became the patron saint of Norway. The hoard now holds an estimated 5,500 coins.
